scope: Supplementary ordinary-Lean and host comparisons for child and worker startup after Linux cwd deletion and permission revocation. No upstream test or expected-output edits. Not full-suite or cross-platform conformance.
changes: Deno Linux uses a bundled C exec launcher via libc posix_spawn, avoiding Deno CLI cwd lookup and cwd reentry. No JavaScript runs between libc internal fork/vfork and exec.
Node full pthread workers preload the existing worker-local cwd lookup fallback.
Deno full runtimes prepare an unreferenced factory with its own Linux CLONE_FS context and use it only when the application cwd is removed. Application OS cwd is never changed for worker bootstrap.
The private relay preserves shared memory, transferred MessagePorts, worker errors, nested Emscripten exceptions and unreferenced shutdown.
Generated application cache inventories include the launcher module, manifest and binaries; maintainer cache signatures also include native launcher inputs.

retainedIntermediateAttempts.classification: Supplementary fixture preparation error: multiline Lean record indentation. Corrected before the immutable before/after comparison.
Deno removed-cwd control passed while still marked TODO; subsequent clean run removed the obsolete TODO and passed all controls.

26 passes and 4 reported failures (3 timed-out source-launcher subtests plus their parent). Concurrent maintainer source edits invalidated warm build signatures. Clean serial rerun held runtime sources fixed and passed with the same deadlines; failures retained, no timeout relaxed. The initial command also named nonexistent node-process-spawn.test.mjs, so node-spawn.test.mjs was validated explicitly in the clean run.
Found an error relay field loss, repaired by explicit serialization. Also found a supplementary fixture used parentPort.close, which Deno does not implement; natural worker exit is now checked.

The supplementary test wrongly required empty stderr for an intentional uncaught worker error. An unwrapped engine control confirms Deno emits that diagnostic. Final fixture requires byte-identical control stderr and intact error fields.

Freeze preparation rejected the lowered compiler original lasm-emscripten-pre.js filename. The matcher now accepts both verified original prelude filenames; partial v87 retained and fresh v88 used. No Lean comparison ran during this preparation failure.

remainingLimitations: Independent virtual cwd permission inheritance when it differs from actual OS cwd.
Non-Linux cwd identity and native validation on macOS, Windows and ARM64.
The Deno removed-cwd worker fallback requires unshare(CLONE_FS). Sandboxes denying it retain ordinary worker startup but cannot use this fallback.
Complete musl-host conformance has not been executed.
The packaged cooperative scheduler remains separate from the experimental full pthread runtime.
The full upstream suite remains incomplete; these supplementary comparisons do not establish all remaining differences are fundamental.
